name: Priestly Counselor
body:
You have experience in listening to and talking to people, using your faith to comfort and persuade.

Prerequisite(s): 4 ranks in Knowledge (religion), Community Domain.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus to Sense Motive checks and may add 1/4 of your Knowledge (religion) ranks as a bonus to Diplomacy checks.
